translated_text: I bow to the Arihants, to the Siddhas, to the Acharyas, to the Upadhyayas, and to all the Sadhus of the world.
original_text: Namo Arihantanam, Namo Siddhanam, Namo Ayariyanam, Namo Uvajjhayanam, Namo Loe Savva Sahunam.
title: Namokar Mantra (The Five Reverences)
transliteration: Namo Arihantanam, Namo Siddhanam, Namo Ayariyanam, Namo Uvajjhayanam, Namo Loe Savva Sahunam.

translated_text: I forgive all living beings, may all living beings forgive me.
original_text: Khamemi savve jīvā, savve jīvā khamantu me.
title: Kshamavani (Prayer for Forgiveness)
transliteration: Khamemi save jiva, save jiva khamantu me.

translated_text: Whatever evil I have done in this life through body, speech, or mind.
original_text: Iriyā vayam pavattittā, je miṃ kiñci pāvayaṃ.
title: Micchami Dukkadam (Seeking Forgiveness)
transliteration: Iriya vayam pavattitta, je mi kinci pavayam.

translated_text: All those whom I have hurt or harmed, I forgive them all.
original_text: Jō sattā dūsai, tē sabbē pi khamēmi.
title: Pratikramana (Repentance Prayer)
transliteration: Jo satta dusai, te sabbe pi khamemi.

translated_text: Salutation to the Arihants, to the Siddhas, to the great teachers.
title: Navkar Mantra (Ninefold Prayer)

translated_text: The perfectly enlightened Blessed One, the Worthy One, the Fully Self-Enlightened One.
title: Pranam Manjari (Salutation Collection)

translated_text: I eat this food with knowledge, free from attachment.
title: Bhatta Parikramana (Food Repentance)

translated_text: I bow to the Arihants, the accomplished ones, the teachers, the preceptors, and all monks. By bowing to these five, I invoke their blessings for the removal of all karmic impurities.
original_text: Namo Arihantanam, Namo Siddhanam, Namo Ayariyanam, Namo Uvajjhayanam, Namo Loe Savva Sahunam. Eso Panch Namokkaro, Savva Pavappanasano, Mansion samam savvesu, Mokkhae Magamamtiyae.
title: Panch Namokar (Five Reverences with Invocation)
transliteration: Namo Arihantanam, Namo Siddhanam, Namo Ayariyanam, Namo Uvajjhayanam, Namo Loe Savva Sahunam. Eso Panch Namokkaro, Savva Pavappanasano, Mansion samam savvesu, Mokkhae Magamamtiyae.

translated_text: Worthy are the crossers of the stream, the middle path, the freed.
title: Sallekhana Vow (Renunciation Prayer)

translated_text: Non-violence is the supreme religion, as taught in the scriptures.
original_text: Ahimsā paramo dharmaḥ, tathā cānye pavacane.
title: Ahimsa Prarthana (Prayer for Non-Violence)
transliteration: Ahimsa paramo dharma, tatha cable pavacane.
